{"id":1862488372,"question_id":125,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months","timestamp":1766414903,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1862488372/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Valid Palindrome","memory":"10.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool isPalindromeCheck(string &str)\n    {\n        int i = 0 , j = str.size() - 1;\n        while(i < str.size() && j >= 0)\n        {\n            if(str[i] != str[j]) return false;\n            else\n            {\n                i++; j--;\n            }\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n    bool isPalindrome(string s) {\n        int n = s.size();\n        string new_s = \"\";\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            if(!(islower(s[i]) or isupper(s[i]) or isdigit(s[i]))) continue;\n            else new_s.push_back(tolower(s[i]));\n        }\n        cout<<new_s;\n        if(new_s.empty()) return true;\n        return isPalindromeCheck(new_s);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"valid-palindrome","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1375}
